```pipeline
read data/LHD_FXX_0657_6868_PTS_O_LAMB93_IGN69.copc.laz --statistics
! filter --vega "datum.classification == 2"
! sql "SELECT CASE classification WHEN 2 THEN 'Ground' WHEN 3 THEN 'Low vegetation' WHEN 4 THEN 'Medium vegetation' WHEN 5 THEN 'High vegetation' WHEN 6 THEN 'Building' ELSE 'Other' END AS label, min(CASE classification WHEN 2 THEN 0 WHEN 3 THEN 1 WHEN 4 THEN 2 WHEN 5 THEN 3 WHEN 6 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END) AS o, CAST(count(*) AS DOUBLE) AS n FROM input GROUP BY CASE classification WHEN 2 THEN 'Ground' WHEN 3 THEN 'Low vegetation' WHEN 4 THEN 'Medium vegetation' WHEN 5 THEN 'High vegetation' WHEN 6 THEN 'Building' ELSE 'Other' END ORDER BY o"
! chart arc --theta n:Q --color label:N
```
